subject: Kickoff: outcomes, timeline & roles for evaluation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@medisync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: outcomes, timeline & roles for evaluation

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for taking the time with us last week. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan to align on measurable outcomes, owners, and a target close/eval timeline so we can get a pilot started quickly. Below is a proposed baseline — please confirm edits and stakeholders.

Quick context / objectives:
- Primary goal: validate Redwood’s inference stack on Medisync anonymized clinical logs for extraction accuracy and latency at 95th percentile.
- Success criteria: 1) FHIR extraction accuracy >= 92% on evaluation set; 2) end-to-end 95th p latency < 400ms at pilot throughput; 3) no PII leakage in logs (security sign-off).

Proposed timeline (4 weeks):
1) Week 0 (this week): finalize MAP & stakeholders; security questionnaire kick-off.
2) Week 1: sample data handoff + test harness setup; initial inference run.
3) Week 2: iterative tuning (batching/quantization) + QA.
4) Week 3: final runs, evaluation report + go/no-go decision.

Proposed owners (please confirm):
- Medisync champion: Sofia Martinez (you) — overall decision owner
- Procurement: Liam O’Rourke — contract/PO owner
- Security: Nisha Rao — compliance owner
- Redwood AE/PM: Karthik Iyer — MAP facilitator
- Redwood CSM: Marissa Cole — operational lead
- Redwood SE: Jonas Weber — integration & performance lead

Attachments: [Attachment: proposed_MAP_template.xlsx (12KB)]
I’ve also added a lightweight MAP template and a draft SLA (will circulate once we have procurement contact confirmed).

Next steps asked of Medisync: please confirm the stakeholders above and your availability for a 30–45 minute kick-off call (I can do Monday or Tuesday mornings PT). Once we have that I’ll lock the MAP doc and assign owners.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--

From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@medisync.com>

Subject: Re: Kickoff: outcomes, timeline & roles for evaluation

Thanks Karthik — this looks great and aligned with what we discussed. Confirming a few things on our side:

- I’ll be the champion and primary owner for the evaluation (Sofia Martinez).
- Procurement: Liam O’Rourke (liam.orourke@medisync.com) — I’ve cc’d him out-of-band; he will handle the PO once we agree terms.
- Security/compliance: Nisha Rao (nisha.rao@medisync.com) — she’ll own the questionnaire and sign-off on PII controls.
- Tech lead: Dr. Elena Gomez (elena.gomez@medisync.com) — will be the day-to-day contact for dataset and validation queries.

Availability: I can do Monday 6/1 at 10:00 AM PT or Tuesday 6/2 at 9:00 AM PT for a kick-off call. Please pick one and include the SE for the integration discussion.

One request up front: can you add a short scoping row in the MAP template for "minimum dataset size" and "sample delivery format" — Dr. Gomez will use that to confirm feasibility.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Sofia Martinez
VP, Data & AI | Medisync
sofia.martinez@medisync.com
